dependencies: Phase 48: spread_filter, economic_calendar, strategy_fitness, pair_blacklist, trade_attribution, walkforward_optimizer
Phase 49: pipeline wiring of all Phase 48 modules
goal: Activate the data layer: restore trade journal, seed calibration/fitness modules from 522 historical trades, extract win-rate patterns, and add safety floors. Target: transform static modules into data-driven decision engines.

acceptance_criteria: Restore trade_journal_rl.json from .bak if empty (atomic copy with validation)
Create src/scanner/journal_analyzer.py with JournalAnalyzer class
Extract win rate by: pair, confidence_band (5 bins), duration_band, exit_reason
Identify top 3 highest-confidence patterns (min 20 observations, p<0.05)
Generate pattern_report dict with actionable thresholds
Write report to trained_data/models/journal_patterns.json atomically
At least 10 unit tests
stories.notes: Journal restored (522 entries). JournalAnalyzer with Z-test significance. Found 5 significant patterns. Report saved to trained_data/models/journal_patterns.json.
stories.title: Restore trade journal and build pattern extraction script

acceptance_criteria: Create src/scanner/calibration_seeder.py with CalibrationSeeder class
Extract (entry_confidence, trade_won) pairs from 522 trades
Fit Platt scaling: P(win|conf) = sigmoid(a*conf + b) via logistic regression
Validate on 20% holdout: measure calibration error
Save fitted coefficients to trained_data/models/calibration_params.json
Wire into confidence_calibration.py as initial state (fallback if no live data)
At least 8 unit tests
stories.notes: CalibrationSeeder with Platt scaling gradient descent. Fitted a=0.85, b=-0.24 but cal_error=0.36 (invalid). Confidence→win relationship is weak. Params saved for future recalibration.
stories.title: Seed confidence calibration from historical trades

acceptance_criteria: Create src/scanner/fitness_seeder.py with FitnessSeeder class
Group 522 trades by pair (13 pairs × ~40 trades each)
Calculate per-pair: rolling_profit_factor, win_rate, avg_pnl_pips
Populate strategy_fitness state with historical fitness scores per pair
Write seeded state to trained_data/models/strategy_fitness_state.json
StrategyFitnessDetector loads seeded state on init if no live state exists
At least 8 unit tests
stories.notes: FitnessSeeder computed per-pair fitness for 13 pairs. 4 SKIP pairs identified (AUD_JPY, EUR_GBP, EUR_USD, USD_CHF). State saved to trained_data/models/strategy_fitness_state.json.
stories.title: Seed strategy fitness from historical journal data

acceptance_criteria: Replace hardcoded trail_mult=1.5 in update_trailing_stops() with regime-aware multiplier
Lookup regime from regime_detector output (LOW=2.0, NORMAL=2.5, HIGH=3.0, EXTREME=4.0)
Apply confidence scaling: confidence_scale = 0.8 + (confidence * 0.4)
Final trail_distance = atr * regime_mult * confidence_scale
Graceful fallback to 1.5x if regime/confidence unavailable
Log regime and confidence used for trailing stop adjustment
At least 8 unit tests
stories.notes: Regime-aware trailing: LOW=2.0x, NORMAL=2.5x, HIGH=3.0x, EXTREME=4.0x. Confidence scaling 0.8-1.2x. Graceful fallback to 1.5x default.
stories.title: Wire adaptive trailing stop with confidence and regime scaling

acceptance_criteria: Add COMPOUND_GATE_FLOOR = 0.10 constant in execution.py
After compound multiplication, clamp: max(compound, COMPOUND_GATE_FLOOR)
Log warning when floor is applied (indicates triple-gate reduction)
Add config field compound_gate_floor to ExecutionConfig with default 0.10
If all three gates reduce simultaneously, log aggregate warning with details
At least 5 unit tests
stories.notes: Compound gate floor=0.10 clamped in execution.py. Individual gate multipliers tracked in ctx for diagnostic logging. Zero-compound (blocked trade) bypasses floor.
stories.title: Add compound gate floor and gate interaction safety

acceptance_criteria: At least 15 integration tests across all Phase 50 modules
Full test suite passes with 0 failures
State files updated atomically (state.json, learnings.md, prd_phase50.json)
Journal restore verified: len(trade_journal_rl.json) == 522
stories.notes: 39 tests passing (201 total with P48+P49). Lazy imports for 3 new modules. Journal patterns, calibration params, and fitness state persisted.
stories.title: Integration tests and state file updates
